subject: Make the annual-map page the single Marktäcke page
description: Tobias asked on 2026-11-03 to merge the Marktäckekartering sub-tab into the annual-map page so the information about what you create sits where you create it, approved a mockup and chose to build it as a PR. Scope: docs/lclu.html gains 'Så skapas din årskarta' (the example tile's inputs, training label and result, with sources and legends) and 'Hur väl stämmer kartan?' (the four summary cards, the qualitative lede and the method); the nfi_validation tab content, its TAB_CONFIG entry and dead inspector code are removed; the Marktäcke sub-tab nav links to lclu.html; the teaser privacy tests now guard the new location. Tobias chose to leave out the qualitative results table, the three observations and the Prithvi image. Not in scope: scripts' MANIFEST output, the API-hosted page's image serving, model results of any kind. Review: Codex.
